title: Risk, Drawdown, Portfolio Stability and Market-Regime Assessment
risk_metrics: exposure and time above exposure thresholds

fold_methodology.trade_attribution: Full stock-leg P&L assigned to the fold of its signal date.
fold_methodology.calendar_risk: Daily mark-to-market dates inherit the most recent validation-fold label; overlapping positions can originate in prior folds.

market_regime_methodology.nifty_trend_and_market_risk: Existing Part 3 daily discrimination labels, joined by signal date.
market_regime_methodology.elevated_vix: India VIX close > fold-specific 75th percentile computed from the 120 sessions strictly before each validation start; threshold is frozen per fold.
market_regime_methodology.trade_attribution: Full seven-session trade P&L attributed to market regime on the signal date.
market_regime_methodology.daily_exposure: Daily exposure associated with the same-date regime; exit-tail dates without a validation signal regime are excluded from regime exposure summaries.

prediction_reliability_methodology.positive_state: Both trailing 20-matured-date mean IC and mean top-bottom realised spread are > 0.
prediction_reliability_methodology.weak_state: Both trailing 20-matured-date mean IC and mean top-bottom realised spread are <= 0.
prediction_reliability_methodology.mixed_state: The two trailing measures have different signs.
prediction_reliability_methodology.important_limitation: This is a past-only historical ranking-quality proxy, not model confidence, a calibrated probability, or a validated position-sizing rule. It does not alter historical exposure.

limitations: This is descriptive analysis of previously reviewed out-of-fold predictions and fixed-quantity historical replays, not independent final-holdout evidence.
Seven-session target returns overlap; fold and market-regime groups are dependent and descriptive. No new significance tests or multiple-testing adjustment are applied.
Drawdowns and tail metrics are based on simulated daily liquidation equity under the specified fee/slippage assumptions.
Daily OHLC cannot reproduce order-book depth, partial fills, market impact, auction execution, corporate actions or dividends.
Signal-origin regime attribution assigns each complete seven-session trade to its entry signal's regime; the market may change during the holding period.
The trailing reliability state is retrospective monitoring research. It must not be used as a live risk gate without a separately frozen and forward-tested policy.
NIFTY and VIX regime definitions are inherited or reconstructed from the earlier Phase 15 regime methodology; small groups are flagged descriptive-only.
